crafts.name: Décor Tray
instructions: Cut the pizza box in half
Take one half of the pizza box and cut off all the flaps
Take the other half of the pizza box and glue the sides, this will be the base box
Cover the first half with wrapping paper using double sided tape
Cover the second half with wrapping paper as well
Glue the first half into the base box
Fill with décor items and done!
crafts.sustainibility_note: The hard cardboard makes the tray durable and functional.
environmental_benefits: Prevents release into landfills that could release toxic methane gases

crafts.name: Wall Hanging Décor
instructions: Open up the pizza box completely
Draw shapes and designs that you want
Cut out the shapes and paint them
Hot glue 2-8 toilet paper rolls together lengthwise depending on how long you want the wall hanging to be
Hot glue the shapes to the string, the number of strings depending on how many rows of shapes and designs you want
Hot glue the strings to the toilet paper rolls row
Add final touches and done! Hang it up!
crafts.sustainibility_note: The pizza box is reused to make a lightweight and portable wall décor!
environmental_benefits: Prevents accumulation in landfills and damage to environment
